title: Hajime no Ippo
subtitle: The spirit of a champion
description: A legendary boxing anime that beautifully captures the essence of hard work, discipline, and the pursuit of strength. Watching Ippo transform from a bullied high schooler into a professional boxer through relentless training is a constant source of motivation.
quotes: Not everyone who works hard is rewarded, but all those who succeed have worked hard.
What does it mean to be strong?
Stand up! You're not done yet!
